name: Renegade Row
instructions: Get into a high plank with hands on dumbbells and feet wide.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Lower it and row the other side.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A plank-position row with dumbbells that trains the upper back and core.
